# Support

- **Using Texfolia:** read the [documentation](../apps/docs/README.md) or the
  guides on [texfolia.com](https://www.texfolia.com).
- **Found a bug or have an idea:** open an
  [issue](https://github.com/texfolia/texfolia/issues/new/choose).
- **Security problem:** follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md) instead of
  opening an issue.
